 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Ajay Kumar Sinha
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Chandra Bhushan Prasad, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Satyavrat Verma

1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State, Mr. Chandra Bhushan Prasad.
2.

The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner seeks anticipatory bail in connection with Tankuppa P.S. Case No. 67 of 2023, for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 341, 323, 504 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 and 4 of the D.P. Act.
3. It is next submitted that investigation in the case is still going on.
4. The learned APP, Mr. Chandra Bhushan Prasad, submits that the offence for which the instant FIR has been instituted, carries punishment of less than seven years, the said Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.28204 of 2024(2) dt.16-04-2024 submission of the learned APP is not disputed by learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner.

5. In view of the submission made by the learned APP, the anticipatory bail application is disposed of in terms of the order dated 13-2-2024 passed in Criminal Miscellaneous No. 3536 of 2024 (Naushad Ansari vs. the State of Bihar).
